correctness.rationale: Multiplicativity reduces ν5(σ(n)) to nonnegative prime-power contributions. Reconstructed the odd-prime local valuation from the 2020 parent formula/LTE: q≡1 mod5 contributes ν5(a+1); q≡4 contributes ν5(a+1)+ν5(q+1) for odd a; q≡2,3 contributes ν5(a+1)+ν5(q²+1) when 4|(a+1); q=5 contributes 0. Setting contribution≥1 or exactly=1 gives all stated residue/exponent and mod25 clauses. If 5∤σ(n), every q≡4 mod5 has even valuation in n; its set has density zero by divergence of reciprocal primes in that progression. The finite checker confirms a sample only, not the infinite theorem.
